ننتفخ (form VIII)
# نَنْتَفِخُ (nantafiḵu) /nan.ta.fi.xu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَفَخَ (intafaḵa)
# نَنْتَفِخَ (nantafiḵa) /nan.ta.fi.xa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَفَخَ (intafaḵa)
# نَنْتَفِخْ (nantafiḵ) /nan.ta.fix/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَفَخَ (intafaḵa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
